name: Fairness Guarded by Throughput
description: Improve fairness by reweighting per-UE scheduling while enforcing a throughput guardrail based on an externally provided baseline. The xApp raises weightUE for low-throughput UEs only when windowed throughput stays within a small drop tolerance. It may increase drop ratio if fairness gains are large.

control_parameters.semantic: Per-UE scheduling weights used by the scheduler to bias PRB allocation toward fairness.
